style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

The below is ⟦0⟧ player suggested strategies for ⟦1⟧. Bear in mind, due to the dynamic nature of the game, it may unfold differently for other players.

Xibei San Ma starts off with very little resources and little factories. However, they do have a decent amount of manpower as well as 7 units so you can train some up. Choose what focuses you want to do and purchase resources and build up factories. After some time has passed you can attack ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, and ⟦3⟧. You can then wait for the Japanese invasion and attack ⟦4⟧ along with ⟦5⟧. You can also join the Japanese faction too. Then you can betray the Japanese and take them over.
Allying yourself with the Chinese United Front

You can do the same as before except this time when ⟦0⟧ attacks, join the Chinese United Front and ask the Chinese for Military access. You and the A.I. should be able to fight off the Japanese and win the war.

Pick "Develop Golog" as the first focus. Immediately rush it down until you get everything necessary to produce and build anything. Your goal will be to declare and unite all of the Ma nations as soon as possible, even sooner depending if ⟦0⟧ decides to go with its fascist branch or not. Take "Strengthening Our Position" and go for opposition, in order to go down and produce and get more manpower out of it. Pick "Strike at the Traitors" instead of "Demand Submission" as the latter focus will take on forever to integrate and finally form Qinghai Ma as the original ⟦1⟧.

If the player wants to do the other part, make sure you prepare yourself to fight Sinkiang too, the player only has to worry about ⟦0⟧ and any of the eastern Chinese nations, in order to go as far as unite all of China. Fighting the Ma's can be relatively tedious. Gansu Ma and Khotan Ma being relatively easy to take down with the outmanoeuvring strategy. Ningxia Ma as well, but it would put a small fight compared to the other two. If the player has finally taken Gansu Ma, go for Khotan Ma, first and then Ningxia Ma second. Khotan Ma falls weak and defeated against the looming war with Sinkiang, so if the player wishes to incorporate cores faster, then Khotan Ma has to go first. Finally with Ningxia Ma last, by using the same outmanoeuvring and pin down attack strategies, Qinghai Ma can form Xibei San Ma. With this done and if the player has completed all of the warlord focuses of Qinghai Ma. Be sure to have completed "The Military Governor Branch" of Qinghai Ma. As you have to declare war on Communist China, Be sure that you've completed "Sweep Out Communists" to buff the attack and defense against them. The territory and front is unfavorable, so you have to lure them out, outmaneuvre them and capture the victory points. Pick the focus of "The Civilian Governor Remains" to get the best spirit, as it helps with supply issues. With all of the warlord focuses finished and now in the generic Nationalist China's focuses, it is time to rush and go for Warlord subjugation in the generic Nationalist China focus tree. It would give a few wargoals for the player to strike and annex the warlords. Alternatively, go with the "Invite Foreign Investors" by rushing down all the way until you reach the "One China Policy".

Considering that the "Renegotiate the Unequal Treaties" focus is usually bypassed as Xibei San Ma doesnt have the national spirit. If China and the rest of the East sided warlords are at war with Japan, it is a good opportunity to pick targets one by one. Be vary of the territories. Of the said nations. The Northeastern Army, in comparison to Sichuan and Communist China, is an easier target. Whereas the other two tend to increase their army, and utilize their mountainous terrain. In alternative to that, use the border conflict decision missions as an alternative to gain territory against the neighbors. Make sure to fix the supply routes, research trains and improve on division templates. Otherwise, if that proves to be obsolete, simply declare war on them by "One China Policy" focus, battle them in a preferable terrain. Or, research mountaineer divisions to fare better in the mountainous battlefields.
